card.statement:
([Lee23, Theorem 1.2]).

Fix a conical Hamiltonian symplectic resolution $X$ with isolated $T$ -fixed points. Then for almost all $p$ and $x\in H^{2}_{T}(X;\mathbb{F}_{p})$ , we have

(3.15)

$\Sigma_{x}^{T}=\nabla_{x}^{p}-t^{p-1}\nabla_{x}+N$

where $N$ is a nilpotent operator.

The right hand side expression, $\nabla_{x}^{p}-t^{p-1}\nabla_{x}$ , is the operator known as the $p$ -curvature of the quantum connection. Although the connection $\nabla_{x}$ is not $\hat{\Lambda}$ -linear, the $p$ -curvature $\nabla_{x}^{p}-t^{p-1}\nabla_{x}$ remarkably is $\hat{\Lambda}$ -linear.

Conjecturally the nilpotent error always vanishes, that is, the quantum Steenrod operators (on degree $2$ classes) are expected to be always equal to the $p$ -curvature of the quantum connection. Current proof for this conjecture assumes generic semisimplicity, as follows. Recall that a collection of commuting linear operators $\{F_{i}\}$ (with $[F_{i},F_{j}]=0$ ) acting on a vector space $V$ over a field $K$ have jointly simple spectrum if the associated simultaneous eigendecomposition of $V\otimes_{K}\overline{K}$ is into $1$ -dimensional subspaces.
card.label: Theorem 3.9

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
